action.openProjectFile: Open a project file (search by name)
action.searchTerminals: Search the output of all terminals
action.history: History: agent jobs, time and cost per project, CSV export
action.pinSelection: Pin the selected text in a note
action.newTab: New tab (default command of a new tab)
action.splitPane: Split the pane to the right / to the bottom
action.closeTab: Close the selected tab (twice, to avoid accidents)
action.backForwardPaneFocus: Back / forward through the panes that had the focus
action.goToWorkspace: Go to workspace 1 to 9 (order of the list of workspaces)
action.chooseResult: Choose a result (palette, search) then confirm
action.closeFileTab: Close the tab (confirmation if not saved)
action.fileMenu: New file or folder, rename / move, Trash
action.collapseSidebars: Collapse or expand the left sidebar / the right sidebar
action.fontSize: Increase / decrease / reset the font size of the whole window
action.issuePreview: On #12 / !34: preview of the issue or merge request; on a URL or a commit: open it
action.fileAtLine: On src/app.ts:42 quoted in a terminal: the file at that line, in the explorer
action.actionButtons: Action buttons: ↗ Open, ⧉ Preview, ▷ Launch, ▷ Run, ▷ View <agent>
action.selectText: Select text, even in "Mouse for the app" mode
action.rename: Rename a workspace, a tab or a pane
action.pin: Pin a pane: it stays visible whatever the tab or workspace
action.subAgentTiles: Tiles of a Claude session: what each sub-agent is doing
